description: A project whose lock holds Hermes' own copy of a skill (.hermes/skills) once Codex is a target too ("targets": ["codex", "hermes"], hook trusted, "claude": false): check counts it as targetsChanged for the project; the sync removes Hermes' copy and installs the Codex copy in .agents/skills, which serves Hermes, with the run note; check then finds nothing; the CLI's status and resync.
